datasets.title: Global Integrated Power
datasets.description: Global dataset of power stations and facilities
datasets.purpose: To provide comprehensive unit-level data on global power stations and facilities across thermal and renewable energy sectors for energy analysis, planning, and policy development worldwide.
datasets.details: The Global Integrated Power Tracker (GIPT) is a multi-sector dataset of power stations and facilities worldwide. The tracker provides unit-level information on thermal power (coal, oil, gas, nuclear, geothermal, bioenergy) and renewables (solar, wind, hydro).

sources.name: Global Energy Monitor
sources.description: Global Integrated Power (GIP) database maintained by Global Energy Monitor (GEM). Tracks power plants and electricity grid infrastructure worldwide including capacity, fuel type, technology, ownership, and development status. Data compiled through open-source research using public records, regulatory filings, and satellite imagery. Updated continuously; global spatial coverage.
